limitations: Subcritical limiting density not evaluated in elementary form. Symmetric non-Gaussian stable Lévy flights, iid renewal reset times independent of motion, start and reset at fixed fraction of growing interval. No uniform convergence rates or general reset dependencies.
scientific_integrity: Analytic small-time Lévy exit estimates and exact cycle-renewal transforms are used. No independence or external certification is claimed. Theorems are for specified finite-mean and Lomax renewal clocks only.
title: A logarithmic reset-clock boundary for marked Levy-flight escape
